name: Vercel Domains
summary: Vercel Domains lets you search for and buy a domain at cost from the same dashboard used to host your project on Vercel.

free_plan_covers.note: Vercel Domains has no free plan; every domain is a paid purchase billed once a year.

first_paid_usd_month.note: There's no monthly plan; domains are billed once a year, not monthly.

portability.note: Vercel's own supported-domains list marks .com as transfer-supported, and the usual ICANN rule still applies that a domain must be registered 60 days before it can transfer.

com_first_year_usd.note: Vercel shows each domain's live at-cost price only in its search tool at checkout rather than publishing a fixed rate, and that live search blocked automated checking as suspected bot traffic, so this number isn't confirmed.

com_renewal_usd.note: Renewal pricing is shown live per domain in the Vercel dashboard rather than published as a fixed rate, and that couldn't be confirmed by automated checking.

whois_privacy_free.note: WHOIS privacy is turned on by default at no extra cost for any TLD that supports it, and Vercel's own table lists .com as supported.

dns_included.note: Buying through Vercel sets up its nameservers automatically, so DNS records are managed free in the same dashboard.

setup.step: Search for and buy the domain at vercel.com/domains.
If the project is hosted on Vercel, nameservers are configured automatically; otherwise add the A and CNAME records your host gives you in the project's Domains settings.
Add any SPF, DKIM or DMARC records your email service gives you as DNS records in the same Domains dashboard.

builder_notes: Buying the domain through Vercel auto-configures Vercel's nameservers, so no manual DNS setup is needed if the project is also hosted on Vercel.
Add the email service's SPF, DKIM and DMARC records in the Domains dashboard before assuming outgoing email works; Vercel does not provide email sending itself.
If a script manages domains through the Vercel Domains REST API, keep the access token server-side and out of git.
